title: OS Studio Parameters
description: Introduce studio-level parameters in the OS core (numeric, categorical, toggle, text with constraints), a third Parameters workbench tab with a fully editable tree, port-only parameter input channels on app nodes in the media flow graph, and per-app bindable detail fields so apps consume parameter values instead of hardcoded ones.
summary: Introduced studio-level parameters in OS core: typed parameter model (numeric, categorical, toggle, text) with constraints, CQRS commands with undo, port-only parameter input channels on app media graph nodes, JSON-pointer value flow into app materialization, and parameter.value resource kind. Added Parameters workbench tab with full tree editing, Inspection panel field binding per app registration parameterFields, and demo fixture seed. Verified with os-core vitest (8 tests) and runtime verify script.
